pin_title: 7 Cleaning & Laundry Buys Under £20 UK Homes Swear By
pin_hook: Small buys that make cleaning day easier
pin_description: Highly rated cleaning and laundry buys under £20 for UK homes: spray mop, microfibre cloths, stain remover powder, stain pens, washing machine cleaner and limescale remover spray. Handy cleaning hacks and laundry essentials. #ad #cleaningtips #laundryhacks #ukhome #cleaninghacks
intro: A few no-fuss cleaning and laundry buys that UK shoppers keep repurchasing - none of them cost more than a takeaway.

products.name: Spray Mop with 5 Washable Pads
products.headline: Mop floors in half the time
products.why: A built-in sprayer and washable pads make quick floor cleans far less of a chore, and it's a genuine bestseller with thousands of reviews.

products.name: MR.SIGA Microfibre Cleaning Cloths, 12 Pack
products.headline: Streak-free cleaning, no paper towels needed
products.why: Reusable, lint-free cloths that shoppers rate highly for leaving surfaces and glass streak-free without chemicals.

products.name: Vanish Gold Crystal White Stain Remover Powder
products.headline: Whites back to bright, no bleach needed
products.why: A laundry cupboard staple for lifting stains and brightening whites without the harshness of bleach.

products.name: Tide to Go Instant Stain Remover Pens, 3 Pack
products.headline: Zap spills before they set
products.why: A pocket-sized pen for tackling spills the moment they happen, handy for school uniforms and work clothes alike.

products.name: Calgon 4-in-1 Washing Machine Cleaner and Water Softener Tablets
products.headline: Protect your machine from limescale build-up
products.why: Drop one in with a wash to help clear limescale and odours, especially useful in the UK's harder water areas.

products.name: Dettol Washing Machine Cleaner, Lemon
products.headline: Freshen up a smelly washing machine
products.why: A dedicated deep-clean for the drum and seals that tackles the musty smell a normal wash cycle won't shift.

products.name: Viakal Limescale Remover Spray Classic
products.headline: Melts away hard water marks on taps and glass
products.why: A go-to bathroom spray for cutting through limescale on taps, showerheads and glass without much scrubbing.
